decisions.reason: The companion fouling detection system was already withdrawn and the automation's website presence has not grown, which weakens its prospects, but it runs as a software module on the existing automation platform and costs little to keep, so the option stays open for another year.
The weir dimensioning web tool is cheap to maintain and supports sales of the new flap weir and flap gate products to engineering planners, so its option value has risen rather than fallen.
The spring-controlled flap weir was launched only in 2024, sits close to the core flood-control hardware business, and its results are still unresolved, so abandoning it now would be premature.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic direction toward digital networking and energy efficiency in water facilities, builds on existing IT modules, and its value is still uncertain, so keeping it costs little.

The overflow flap gate line has several models and a dedicated web page, showing the firm has already committed further to it in its core hydraulic steelwork business, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
